request.query: Prior studies using the UCI Online Shoppers Purchasing Intention Dataset or comparable session-level ecommerce data to estimate whether product-page dwell or dwell per product page interacts with new versus returning visitor status in association with purchase/conversion; identify close empirical and methodological overlaps.
request.missing_relation: Whether the proposed dwell-by-visitor-type interaction is already a routine or directly studied contrast, especially in this dataset.
request.change_if_found: If closely overlapping work exists, do not claim novelty for I1; revise toward a distinct, timestamped sequence or experimental question, or retain I1 only as a replication.
